paths.description: Homepage/listing: core browse surface, global chrome, consent/age state, performance, security and discoverability.
Category index archetype representing taxonomy/listing navigation.
Representative video detail/player gate, metadata and primary content journey.
Primary guest account-creation flow and modal/responsive behaviour.
Intentional missing route representing HTTP/error recovery.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not reduce active animation
findings.evidence: Preference probes found the same eight running 2,000ms animations both normally and under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce rule that disables or shortens non-essential repeating/loading animation.

findings.summary: Route and state changes have no transition continuity
findings.evidence: The CSS/platform probe found zero declared view-transition rules, and route changes between listing, category, signup and detail were instant reloads.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same- or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful listing/detail and overlay state changes, with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long-page chrome does not respond to scroll state
findings.evidence: The long listing keeps a large static header/sidebar; the CSS probe found no scroll-state query/progress treatment and screenshots show no position-aware reduction.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce or contextualise sticky chrome as users scroll, using scroll-state/container techniques with a static fallback.

findings.summary: Load-time consent chrome obscures the primary content
findings.evidence: The first desktop viewport is obscured by a large cookie dialog while a separate age-verification banner and dense chrome remain visible behind it.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce the consent panel footprint, preserve immediate context, and keep accept, decline and settings equally accessible.

findings.summary: Custom overlays replace semantic dialog primitives
findings.evidence: DOM probes found zero native dialog/popover/details elements; signup uses a custom role=dialog overlay and the cookie prompt is custom chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement modal flows with <dialog> and declarative close actions; use popover only for transient non-modal UI.

findings.summary: Persistent chrome crowds out mobile content
findings.evidence: At 360px, persistent header, age banner and 207px sidebar leave a narrow clipped content column; the first viewport is dominated by chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse the sidebar and simplify banners/navigation below narrow breakpoints so content owns the viewport.

findings.summary: Narrow viewports retain a 1024px desktop layout
findings.evidence: Layout at a 360px visual viewport measured scrollWidth 1024 and 664px horizontal overflow; the signup screenshot places the dialog almost entirely off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed/minimum desktop widths, use intrinsic fluid layout, and verify scrollWidth equals the visual viewport at 360px.

findings.summary: Reused components do not adapt to their containers
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found zero container queries, while reused listing/signup components visibly fail to adapt to the narrow container.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type and @container rules for listing cards, sidebars, banners and account overlays.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch targets are inadequate
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus found outline-style none on key buttons/input, and the target probe found many 16×16 and 20px-high interactive links.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator and enlarge interactive targets to at least 24×24 CSS px, preferably 44×44 for primary touch actions.

findings.summary: The mobile signup journey is off-screen
findings.evidence: The guest signup route at 360px renders its custom dialog mostly beyond the right viewport edge, preventing a mobile user from reading or completing the flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the signup dialog width fluid (max-inline-size: min(...)), center it in the visual viewport, and test completion at 360px.

findings.summary: Post-load scripting creates long main-thread tasks
findings.evidence: Trace/layout captured 2 long tasks, longest 138.6–148ms, and trace total blocking time of 105.2ms after load.
findings.suggestedFix: Split and schedule non-critical work, delay below-fold hydration and ads, and keep tasks below 50ms.

findings.summary: Critical resource delivery is request-heavy
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 144 requests and 1.68MB transferred, including three parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets and a redirect to a different host.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the mirror-host redirect, consolidate critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts, and keep only genuinely critical preloads.

findings.summary: Large and partially unused JavaScript is shipped
findings.evidence: HAR shipped 61 scripts (1.02MB); Lighthouse found 26KiB unused in assetsLoader.js, and the largest index script alone transferred 400KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split the 400KB index bundle, conditionally load account/ad modules, and remove unused loader code.

findings.summary: Important age and metadata text fails contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.75 and found age-banner text at 1.75:1/2.15:1 plus view-count text at 3.29:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise text/background contrast to WCAG AA, especially on the green age banner and gray view metadata.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated
findings.evidence: Focus probe returned outline none and no focus box-shadow on search, login and other primary buttons, so keyboard location is not reliably visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Define consistent :focus-visible outlines with sufficient contrast and do not suppress outlines without a replacement.

findings.summary: Zoom/reflow and target sizing fail on mobile
findings.evidence: The 360px layout overflows by 664px, signup is off-screen, and many controls measure only 16×16 or 20px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix horizontal reflow, allow zoom, and enlarge all actionable icons/text links so the complete flow works without two-dimensional scrolling.

findings.summary: Image delivery lacks dimensions and right-sizing
findings.evidence: Image audit found 29/36 images without dimensions, 12 oversized, 8 below-fold images not lazy, 16 legacy-format assets, and one missing alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio, generate correctly sized responsive sources, lazy-load below-fold media and provide the missing alt.

findings.summary: Localized mirror indexing signals are ambiguous
findings.evidence: Localized German pages expose no hreflang links, while canonical URLs point from the .desi mirror to ge.xhamster.com; indexing intent across host/language variants is ambiguous.
findings.suggestedFix: Add reciprocal hreflang entries (including x-default where appropriate) and ensure canonical/robots/sitemap host strategy is consistent.

findings.summary: Video detail pages omit VideoObject structured data
findings.evidence: The video detail has Open Graph tags but no JSON-LD/VideoObject structured data, limiting machine-readable rich-result metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching the visible title, thumbnail, duration, upload date and canonical URL.

findings.summary: Security response headers provide weak XSS/referrer protection
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS are present, but CSP is only frame-ancestors self and provides no script/style XSS policy; X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP beyond frame-ancestors, add nosniff and a strict Referrer-Policy, and lengthen HSTS after rollout validation.

findings.summary: Guest load exposes a broad third-party data surface
findings.evidence: Network capture contacted 15 third-party origins, including Google Accounts and tsyndicate; the ad request included a persistent xhStatsUid and page keywords.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate advertising/account integrations on consent and intent, minimise identifiers/keywords, and batch first-party analytics with short retention.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers lack nosniff and Referrer-Policy; Permissions-Policy only declares UA client-hint fields and does not restrict sensitive capabilities.
findings.suggestedFix: Restrict Permissions-Policy capabilities, add Referrer-Policy and nosniff, and consider origin isolation/Trusted Types for high-risk script surfaces.

findings.summary: Custom overlay positioning is not resilient
findings.evidence: The custom signup overlay is mostly outside the 360px viewport and there is no native dialog/anchor-position fallback, demonstrating a runtime overlay failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a top-layer dialog with fluid logical sizing and viewport-safe inset constraints; test near every viewport edge.

findings.summary: Account flow is not safely completable on mobile
findings.evidence: The account/signup overlay is not usable at 360px because its content and actions are positioned beyond the right viewport edge.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair the signup dialog reflow and keep pricing/consent/account actions visible, reversible and keyboard reachable at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Media assets are not consistently resolution-optimised
findings.evidence: Image audit found 12 images rendered at less than half natural dimensions, 16 legacy-format results, and 29 missing intrinsic dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive modern-format sources close to rendered size and reserve intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Background and deferred work are heavier than necessary
findings.evidence: The page loads 144 requests and 61 scripts; 26KiB of one loader is unused and post-load long tasks reach 138.6ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer below-fold modules and ad work, remove unused code, and schedule background processing outside interaction-critical windows.

findings.summary: Third-party and script weight is disproportionate on entry
findings.evidence: The 1.68MB load includes 1.02MB of scripts and 142 cross-origin requests by request-origin accounting, plus Google/advertising resources before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Load account, ad and heavy media integrations only after user intent/consent, and enforce a route-specific byte/request budget.

taskList.title: Repair mobile reflow and make signup/account overlays viewport-safe
Restore visible keyboard focus, adequate targets and AA contrast
Strengthen CSP, referrer, permissions and third-party privacy controls
Reduce critical script/request weight and defer background integrations
Use semantic, compact and preference-aware overlays/animation
Right-size images and reserve intrinsic media space
Clarify localized indexing and add VideoObject metadata
Add guided route and scroll continuity
